ranked_evidence.title: Elgar Parishad case: Supreme Court grants six-week interim bail to activist Mahesh Raut on medical grounds  - The Hindu
ranked_evidence.snippet: News and reviews from the world of cinema and streaming. # Elgar Parishad case: Supreme Court grants six-week interim bail to activist Mahesh Raut on medical grounds. ## **Mr. Raut’s counsel apprised the top court that he has been suffering from rheumatoid arthritis and required urgent medical attention**. The Bench ultimately allowed the bail plea after noting that the Bombay High Court had earlier granted regular bail to Mr. Raut, though that order was later stayed by the Supreme Court. The Supreme Court on Tuesday (September 16, 2025) granted interim bail to Elgar Parishad-Bhima Koregaon case accused Mahesh Raut on medical grounds for six weeks. Granting interim relief, the Bench said, “The applicant is seeking bail on medical grounds coupled with the fact that he was actually granted bail. “We are of the considered opinion that there are reasonable grounds for believing the allegations or accusations of the NIA against the appellant having conspired, attempted, advocated and abetted the commission of a terrorist act as prima facie true,” the court had said.
